text.tspan: For anyone juggling more than they admit.
Spent Saturday morning volunteering and came
home tired in a good way.
I met neighbors I had only ever waved at from
a driveway.
Thank the people who coordinate. Coordination
is labor.
— Rami
That is all I have tonight.
Skill-based volunteering multiplies impact
when matched well.
We stayed for cleanup, which is where half the
work lives.
Local problems are not abstract.
Show up consistently beats showing up loudly
once.
Local problems are not abstract.
The organizers needed hands more than they
needed advice.
Small recurring shifts beat rare heroic days.
I put the next date on my calendar before
leaving.
Invite one person with you. Networks grow that
way.

Listen before you redesign someone else's
system.
We followed the intake process instead of
improvising "helpfulness."
Community care is maintenance work.
I asked what skills were scarce instead of
assuming mine were.
Thank the people who coordinate. Coordination
is labor.

Consistency builds trust with organizers and

A regular volunteer taught me the unglamorous
backbone tasks.
